brief:
A Palestinian succumbed to wounds sustained in an Israeli bombing of the al-Amal neighborhood in Khan Younis, Al Jazeera reported, citing Nasser Hospital in the city. The strike hit the residential area in the southern Gaza enclave, injuring multiple people in the densely populated neighborhood.

The death marks another casualty from Israeli military operations concentrated in Khan Younis during the ongoing conflict. The southern Gaza city has borne repeated airstrikes in recent months, with civilians caught in the crossfire as fighting continues across the territory. Nasser Hospital, one of the few functioning medical facilities in the area, has handled a mounting caseload of wounded and dead from strikes on surrounding neighborhoods.
